verdict.rationale: Penpot's own docs repeatedly call it an open-source design platform, a public GitHub repository (github.com/penpot/penpot) appears in the evidence, and community users treat it as open source. That supports reading its source under an open license, but the specific license is never named and source access is only implied by the repo link. missing for 10: the named open-source license (terms and OSI status), and explicit first-party documentation of where and how to read or obtain the source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Penpot is the only open-source design platform that is truly deployment agnostic.
Open-source alternative with self-hosting, unlimited files, native design tokens.
Nice addition to open source design tools.
